name: Sika CarboShear L
paste:
SIKA® CARBOSHEAR L: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® CarboShear L, March 2025, Version 03.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/d/sika_carboshear_l.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® CarboShear L where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2025, Version 03.01).
1.2 Product description. Sika® CarboShear L carbon fibre shear links are corrosion resistant, designed for strengthening concrete structures in shear and to anchor Sika® CarboDur® plates at their ends. They are part of the Sika® CarboDur® CFRP Strengthening System. Sika® CarboShear L shear links are bonded as external reinforcement using Sikadur®-30 or Sikadur®-30 LP epoxy resin based adhesive.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® CarboShear L may only be used by experienced professionals. Sika® CarboShear L profiles are used as a reinforcement profiles for externally bonded shear structural strengthening systems on concrete for:
    - Increasing the shear load capacity of beams.
    - Reducing the stress on steel reinforcement
    - Changes in building use.
    - Deterioration of the original construction materials
    - Steel reinforcement corrosion
    - Improved fatigue resistance
    - Replacing missing steel reinforcement
    - Passive seismic retrofitting strengthening for to prevent brittle shear failure mechanism
    - Insufficient / inadequate reinforcement
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Please note.
    - A specialist structural engineer must be consulted for any structural strengthening design calculation.
    - The Product may only be used by experienced professionals.
1.5 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.7.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® CarboShear L
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: L-Shaped carbon fibre shear links profiles for structural strengthening. Part of the Sika® CarboDur® System
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports.
    - Czech Republic: Technical Approval, ITC, Nr. STO-AO- 1012/2020/a
    - Technical Agreement, CTPC, No. 016-01/488-2022
    - Slovakia: Technical Assessment, TSUS, No. SK04-ZSV- 2669
    - National Technical Assessment Sika CarboDur® kit, ITB, Approval No. ITB-KOT-2018/0414 v.2
    - Technical Approval Sika CarboDur, Nr. IBDiM-KOT- 2019-0361 v.2
    - EMPA Test Report 169’219 E/1: Testing of CFRP shear strips on reinforced concrete T-beams T1 and T2, Swiss Federal Laboratories for Materials Testing and Research EMPA, 1998
    - EMPA Test Report 169’219 E/2: Testing of CFRP shear strips. Flexural beam T3, Swiss Federal Laboratories for Materials Testing and Research EMPA, 1998
    - EMPA Test Report 116/7: Shear strengthening with prefabricated CFRP L-shaped plates, Test beams S1 to S6, Swiss Federal Laboratories for Materials Testing and Research EMPA, 2002
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 2561: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Laminate elongation at break in tension Mean* (p.2); Technical Information > Laminate modulus of elasticity in tension (p.2); Technical Information > Laminate tensile strength (p.2).
    - EN 61006: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Glass transition temperature (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Tested anchorage system.
    - Non-corroding
    - Very high strength and durability
    - Shear and bursting enhancement.
    - Well defined anchoring.
    - Lightweight.
    - Low overall thickness, can be over coated.
    - Easy transportation.
    - Easy installation – no heavy handling and installation equipment.
    - Outstanding fatigue resistance.
    - Minimal preparation of the shear links is required.
    - Minimal aesthetic impact.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Carbon fibre reinforced polymer with an epoxy matrix, black.
    - Density: 1.55 g/cm³
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Fibre volume content: > 55 %
    - Laminate elongation at break in tension Mean*: 1.60 %; *Values in the longitudinal direction of the fibres, considering a nominal thickness of 2 mm (EN 2561)
    - Glass transition temperature: > +100 °C (EN 61006)
2.7 Dimensions. Sika® CarboShear L is a CFRP L-shaped plate with a 90° bend.
    | Type | Leg length | Leg length | Width | Nominal |
    | short | long | thickness |
    | 4/20/50 | 200 mm | 500 mm | 40 mm | 2 mm |
    | 4/30/70 | 300 mm | 700 mm | 40 mm | 2 mm |
    | 4/50/100 | 500 mm | 1000 mm | 40 mm | 2 mm |
    | 4/80/150 | 800 mm | 1500 mm | 40 mm | 2 mm |
    | The leg length can be cut to size (by saw, or preferably by diamond cutting disk). The inner radius of the bend zone is 25 mm for all sizes |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.8 Laminate tensile strength.
    | Mean* | 1850 N/mm² |
    | 5 % characteristic* | 1700 N/mm² |
    *Values in the longitudinal direction of the fibres, considering a nominal thickness of 2 mm
    Test method printed: (EN 2561)
2.9 Laminate modulus of elasticity in tension.
    | Mean* | 95 000 N/mm² |
    *Values in the longitudinal direction of the fibres, considering a nominal thickness of 2 mm
    Test method printed: (EN 2561)
2.10 System structure. The system build-up and configuration as described must be fully complied with and may not be changed.
    | Resin adhesive | Sikadur®-30 or Sikadur®-30 LP |
    | Structural strengthening carbon | Sika® CarboShear L |
    | plates |
    (System build-up table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows. Refer to the data sheet (page 2) for the layout.)
    For detailed information on Sikadur®-30 or Sikadur®-30 LP, together with the resin and plate application details, please refer to the individual Product Data Sheets and Sika® CarboShear Externally Bonded Shear Reinforcement” Ref: 850 41 06.
2.11 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Packs of 20 links, or individual pieces
    - Shelf life: 4 years from date of production
2.12 Storage conditions. Store in original, unopened, sealed and undamaged packaging in dry conditions at temperatures of max. +50 °C. Protect from direct sunlight. Transportation: only in the original packaging, or otherwise adequately protected against any mechanical damage

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2025, Version 03.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation. Clean and prepare the concrete to achieve a laitance-free, contaminant-free, open-textured surface. Please refer to the “Method Statement Sika® CarboShear Externally Bonded Shear Reinforcement” Ref: 850 41 06.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2025, Version 03.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: Please refer to the “Method Statement Sika® CarboShear Externally Bonded Shear Reinforcement” Ref: 850 41 06.
4.3 To the concrete surface. Recommended minimum concrete pull-off strength after surface preparation:
    - Mean: 2.0 N/mm²
    - Minimum: 1.5 N/mm²
    The effective concrete pull-off strength after surface preparation has to be verified.
    Concrete must generally be older than 28 days (dependent on curing conditions and the type of concrete).
4.4 Important.
    - Application by trained personnel
    - The application of this Product must only be carried out by an applicator that is trained or approved by Sika. The applicator must also be experienced in this type of application.
4.5 Important.
    - Strictly follow installation procedures
    - Strictly follow installation procedures as defined in Method Statements, application manuals and working instructions which must always be adjusted to the actual site conditions.
4.6 Important. Exposure to UV or weathering; The Product is not resistant to permanent UV exposure or weathering. 1. Contact Sika Technical Services for detailed advice. Maximum service temperature; Note: Maximum permissible continuous service temperature is approximately +50 °C. refer to the “Method Statement Sika® CarboShear Externally Bonded Shear Reinforcement” Ref: 850 41 06. Please refer to the relevant Product Data Sheets and method statement:
    - The Product Data Sheet for Sikadur®-30
    - The Product Data Sheet for Sikadur®-30 LP
4.7 Limitations and important considerations. A suitably qualified Structural Engineer must be responsible for the design of the strengthening works. Additionally as this application is structural, great care must also be taken in selecting suitably experienced and trained specialist contractors. Sika® CarboShear strengthening systems with Sika® CarboShear L profiles must be protected from permanent exposure to direct sunlight, moisture and/or water. Please refer to the relevant Method Statement and Product Data Sheets for the selection of suitable over coating materials in situations where systems will be fully or partially exposed. Contact Sika technical service for detailed advice.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.7):
    - A suitably qualified Structural Engineer must be responsible for the design of the strengthening works. Additionally as this application is structural, great care must also be taken in selecting suitably experienced and trained specialist contractors. Sika® CarboShear strengthening systems with Sika® CarboShear L profiles must be protected from permanent exposure to direct sunlight, moisture and/or water. Please refer to the relevant Method Statement and Product Data Sheets for the selection of suitable over coating materials in situations where systems will be fully or partially exposed. Contact Sika technical service for detailed advice.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Recommended minimum concrete pull-off strength after surface preparation:
    - The effective concrete pull-off strength after surface preparation has to be verified.
5.4 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Laminate tensile strength: Mean* | 1850 N/mm²; 5 % characteristic* | 1700 N/mm²; *Values in the longitudinal direction of the fibres, considering a nominal thickness of 2 mm (EN 2561)
    - Laminate modulus of elasticity in tension: Mean* | 95 000 N/mm²; *Values in the longitudinal direction of the fibres, considering a nominal thickness of 2 mm (EN 2561)
    - Laminate elongation at break in tension Mean*: 1.60 %; *Values in the longitudinal direction of the fibres, considering a nominal thickness of 2 mm (EN 2561)
    - Glass transition temperature: > +100 °C (EN 61006)
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® CarboShear L, March 2025, Version 03.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/d/sika_carboshear_l.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.4 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.5 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.6 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
